title: Nexus CreateForkResponse
description: Response body for POST /v1/daemon/worlds/:world_id/forks (200 OK). branch_id is required — P2 PD-6 consumes it immediately to set the forked branch context.

branch_id.description: The newly created fork branch id (fbk_ prefix).

parent_branch_id.description: The branch the new fork diverges from.

forked_from_event_id.description: The event on the parent branch that is the fork point.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of fork creation (the fork_created marker's created_at).
